data.title: This tutorial demonstrates how to build a no-code
data.content:
## Summary
This tutorial demonstrates how to build a no-code e-commerce chatbot using the Chatling.ai platform, capable of handling product inquiries, order tracking, and returns. It covers integrating a custom knowledge base, setting up intent-based routing, and connecting to external APIs for real-time data retrieval.

## Key Points
- Introduction to Chatling.ai as a no-code chatbot builder for e-commerce platforms like Shopify and WordPress.
- Setting up a knowledge base by uploading TXT and PDF documents for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
- Configuring AI personas and instructions to define the chatbot's name, role, and response formatting.
- Using intent triggers to route users to specific flows like order tracking or returns based on sample phrases.
- Implementing LLM-based input validation to verify order number formats before processing requests.
- Integrating external API endpoints via HTTP Request blocks to fetch live order status data.
- Automating support processes by collecting user data and sending emails to human agents or support departments.

## AI Concepts
RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), Knowledge Base, Intent Recognition/Matching, LLM Input Validation, Prompt Engineering, Persona/System Instructions
